_README: Per-tile MANUAL CROP boxes for book-works pictures, in SOURCE PIXELS:
[x0, y0, x1, y1], origin top-left, as PIL Image.crop() takes them.
Key 1 = the art file's own parent folder (phonics-images/satpin-v2/
A listed tile SKIPS prep_art()'s automatic content-box step -- the box
here IS the framing decision -- but is still paper-whitened and centred
on a white square. Unlisted tiles are untouched.
Chosen by eye so the CHARACTER is the subject: its whole face/body plus
a little pit rim, roughly half the frame. See prep_art()/_prep_manual().
